class_semantics.agency_or_system: Codes 10, 12, and 14-25. This includes agency process, data-entry, policy, programming, and computation causes; it is broader than rules-engine logic errors.
class_semantics.client_or_fact: Codes 1-4 and 7. Combining information-not-reported, explicit client codes, and collateral-contact inaccuracy is an analysis superclass, not a codebook-defined binary.
class_semantics.excluded_federal_match: Code 8, kept separate because the codebook says the variance is excluded from error determination even though such elements occur inside some official-error cases.
class_semantics.no_required_action: Code 26; neither client reporting nor agency action required.
class_semantics.other: Code 99; no more specific public semantics.
class_semantics.unclassified: No nonmissing documented AGENCY code; never imputed.

committed_prose_discrepancy.assessment: The 10-case count reproduces from all nine SAV AGENCY slots; neither available dollar definition reproduces $3.28M.

reference.classification: abs(engine_on_original - RAWBEN) <= 5; a miss is a computation-side upper bound, not a proven computation error

AGENCY1-AGENCY9.meaning: Agency or client responsibility; primary cause of variance.

AMOUNT1-AMOUNT9.meaning: Dollar amount of the same-suffix variance.

AMTERR.meaning: Case benefit error: authorized benefit minus the benefit the State should have authorized, expressed as a nonnegative dollar amount.

CASE.meaning: Case classification; code 1 is included in error-rate calculation.

DISCOV1-DISCOV9.meaning: How the same-suffix variance was discovered; not a cause field.

ELEMENT1-ELEMENT9.meaning: Program element affected by the same-suffix variance.

E_FINDG1-E_FINDG9.meaning: Impact of the same-suffix variance: 2 overissuance, 3 underissuance, 4 ineligible. It is not a nature or cause code.

HWGT.meaning: Monthly sample weight. For the 12 monthly FY samples, summing HWGT times a monthly dollar amount gives an annual flow; no extra factor of 12 is applied.

NATURE1-NATURE9.meaning: Nature of the same-suffix variance; not responsibility.

OCCDATE1-OCCDATE9.meaning: Year and month in which the same-suffix variance occurred.

STATE.meaning: FIPS code for State or territory.

TIMEPER1-TIMEPER9.meaning: Timing of the variance relative to the agency's most recent action.

VERIF1-VERIF9.meaning: How the same-suffix variance was verified; not a cause field.

sibling_inventory.meaning: Nine same-suffix variance records; R denotes a field from raw QC data.

case_classes.input_system_caused: No populated finding is computational and at least one populated slot has an agency_or_system AGENCYi cause.
case_classes.mixed: At least one but not every populated finding is computational.
case_classes.pure_math: Every populated finding slot is computational.

conditional_deduction.rule: A deduction nature is computational only when the same suffix's AGENCYi code belongs to agency_or_system.

field_correction.reason: The FY2024 codebook defines E_FINDGi only as impact codes 2-4, defines 520 as arithmetic computation under ELEMENTi, and lists the remaining requested codes under NATUREi.
field_correction.rule: Codes 36, 42, 43, 52, 53, 54, 56, 57, 64, 65, 75, 79, 80, 98, and 123 are NATUREi values. E_FINDGi is not used to identify computational nature. Code 520 is an ELEMENTi value.

lab_regression_rule.reason: The archived Colorado 13/19/13/260 partition reproduces only when system-side means the narrower broad_rules_engine scenario set.
lab_regression_rule.status: legacy cross-check, not the primary classification

populated_finding_slot.reason: The archived lab represented each populated finding as the same-slot tuple (ELEMENTi, NATUREi, AGENCYi).
populated_finding_slot.rule: ELEMENTi is nonmissing; pair ELEMENTi, NATUREi, and AGENCYi by suffix i.

provenance.annualization: The FY file pools 12 monthly samples. HWGT is monthly; pooling monthly dollar flows across all samples already yields annual dollars, so no additional factor of 12 is applied.
provenance.determinism: No timestamps, randomness, locale formatting, or absolute paths.
provenance.element_dollar_formula: sum(HWGT * AMOUNTi) where E_FINDGi in {2,3,4} and AMOUNTi > 0

public_csv.role: independent public-schema audit only; computations use SAV

rounding.calculation_order: aggregate unrounded binary64 values, then round
